title: Complete read-only and remembered command dispatch over the native runtime
scope: Complete start/runCommand read-only-before-interrupt routing and job remember integration using the actual registered callback runtime. Preserve eager settlement before scene admission, null/ready settlement distinction, deadline inside the scene turn, deferred contexts and error normalization without mutation history/activity. Reuse recent result/state components.
acceptance: Independent full pinned read-only/remember command traces compare successful values, failures, state, eager factory/effect order and exact typed errors; retain every earlier registered mutation/interrupt case and wrong-value canary.

Read-only routing precedes interrupts; settling starts before scene waiting and only limited/body is timed inside its scene turn. Deferred skips settling. Late body/progress work remains owned after caller timeout.

Jobs attach once-only reactions to the captured request/receiver; ordered record/update/eviction, Date clipping/durations, omitted results and callback faults match the existing source components. No global reusable request-ID routing.
All original/native/Chrome gates remain required; real scan/session models, import/plane, global undo/project compatibility and CLI M3 remain explicit continuations.
open_items: Next runtime continuation after #99. Read-only definitions are currently refused explicitly; no implementation/acceptance claim.
